verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a warehouse-native Identity Resolution product that links related records and identifiers into one resolved identity across devices and channels. It produces a Golden Record whose canonical values are chosen by survivorship rules. Its event SDKs for browser, iOS and Android, plus identify events, feed that unification. missing for 10: explicit documentation of anonymous-to-known (pre-login) stitching, detail on configurable matching/merge rules beyond survivorship, independent or hands-on corroboration.
